name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the continuation relates to the given context and provided interesting fact. It assesses if the response stays on topic and uses the information effectively.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is not relevant at all and 5 is highly relevant.

name: Engagement
description: Evaluates the ability of the continuation to capture and maintain the interest of the conversation partner. This includes the use of engaging language and stimulating further dialogue.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is not engaging and 5 is highly engaging.

name: Coherence
description: Assesses the logical flow and consistency of the continuation. A coherent response should be easy to follow and make sense within the context of the conversation.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is incoherent and 5 is highly coherent.

name: Creativity
description: Measures the originality and inventiveness of the continuation. A creative response should present ideas or insights that are novel and thought-provoking while remaining appropriate to the context.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is not creative and 5 is highly creative.

name: Tone Appropriateness
description: Evaluates whether the tone of the continuation is suitable for the context and aligns with the intended mood or atmosphere of the conversation.
scale: 1 to 5, where 1 is inappropriate tone and 5 is perfectly appropriate tone.
